title: Protocol for cytokine and uterine immune cell characterization in a mouse model of LPS-induced preterm birth
protocol: Vortex the LPS solution thoroughly to ensure the LPS does not adhere to the tube.
Draw up the LPS solution into a syringe.
Remove any air bubbles from the syringe.
Scruff the pregnant mouse in the non-dominant hand and hold it parallel to the work surface.
Inject the mouse intraperitoneally.
Position the needle with the bevel facing upward between the second set of nipples and nearly parallel to the abdomen.
Inject at the midline to avoid injecting into the uterine horns.
Perform uterine immune cell isolation 6 hours after injection.
Prepare Digestion Buffer with 20°C–22°C RPMI 1640 immediately before experiment.
Add 1 mL of cRPMI to a 15 mL centrifuge tube for each animal.
Keep the tube on ice until step 9.
Euthanize the mouse and open the abdominal cavity.
Remove the uterus from the abdominal cavity.
Discard fetal and placental tissue, retaining only the uterine tissue.
Place the uterine tissue in the 15 mL centrifuge tube with cRPMI.
Mince the uterine tissue with scissors.
Add 1 mL of digestion buffer to the minced uterus.
Incubate the minced uterus in an orbital shaker at 37°C for 45 minutes at 225 RPM.
Filter the sample through a 70 μm filter into 50 mL conical centrifuge tubes.
Rinse the 15 mL centrifuge tube with 10 mL of cRPMI and pour it through the filter for a total volume of 12 mL in the 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of ACK.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C).
Centrifuge at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of cRPMI.
Centrifuge at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of cRPMI.
Remove 10 μL and add it to 90 μL of Trypan blue in a new tube or plate.
Place 10 μL of the cell suspension in a hemocytometer and count immune cells.
Centrifuge the 50 mL tube at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in cRPMI at a maximum concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Plate up to 2 × 10^6 cells (up to 200 μL) in a 96-well round bottom plate.
Plate two extra wells with isolated uterine immune cells for unstained control and viability control (Zombie UV).
Critical: Plate the same number of cells per well for each animal or biological replicate.
If cell yields are variable, multiple wells can be plated for higher yield samples.
Plate a minimum of 50,000 cells per well.
Add one small drop (∼50 μL) of compensation beads to 11 wells (one for each staining antibody, excluding viability control).
Centrifuge the plate for 7 min at 625 × g (1600 RPM) at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from each well.
Add 50 μL of Surface Stain Master Mix to each sample well.
Add 50 μL of FACS Staining Buffer to each single-stained control well, the viability control well, and the unstained control well.
Add the 1× amount of each individual antibody to its single-stained control well.
Add the 1× amount of Zombie UV Dye to the pelleted cells in the viability control well.
Pipette each well up and down to mix.
Incubate the plate for 30 min at room temperature (20°C–22°C) in the dark.
Centrifuge the plate at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 200 μL of cold FACS Washing Buffer by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark if surface staining is incubated at room temperature.
Centrifuge the plate at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 100 μL of BD Cytofix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Centrifuge at 930 × g (2000 RPM) for 4 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 200 μL of cold FACS Washing Buffer.
Prepare IVCCA Antibody Master Mix in a 50 mL conical tube.
Draw up 200 μL of the antibody solution into a syringe for each mouse.
Remove any air bubbles from the syringes.
Inject mice intraperitoneally with the prepared antibody solution.
Position the needle with the bevel facing upward between the second set of nipples and nearly parallel to the abdomen.
After 3 hours, inject mice with LPS according to previous protocol steps.
Collect blood 7 hours after antibody injection (4 hours after LPS injection) into microtainer serum separator tubes.
Centrifuge collected blood at 10,600 × g for 7 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Transfer serum to 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Store serum at -80°C if not immediately used for the assay.
Thaw serum on ice.
Prepare dilution buffer while the serum thaws.
Make biotinylated standards.
Add recombinant protein and injection antibody to dilution buffer as noted.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
After incubation, add dilution buffer to each standard to reach the final concentration.
Make serial dilutions for each standard by removing 25 μL of diluted standard and adding it to 75 μL of dilution buffer.
Repeat the serial dilution process five more times to achieve 1:16, 1:64, 1:128, 1:256, and 1:512 standards.
After thawing, add 125 μL serum to 375 μL of dilution buffer for a 1:4 dilution.
Wash the plate five times with wash buffer.
Load 30 μL of each standard dilution onto the plate in duplicate.
Load 30 μL of dilution buffer onto the plate in duplicate as a blank.
Load 30 μL of the diluted serum onto the plate in duplicate.
Incubate at 20°C–22°C for 40 minutes.
Add 1 μL SA-HRP to 20 mL dilution buffer while the plate incubates.
Store aliquots of SA-HRP mixture at -20°C for future use.
Wash the plate 5 times with wash buffer after incubation.
Add 30 μL diluted SA-HRP to each well and incubate for 25 min at 20°C–22°C.
Wash the plate 10 times with wash buffer.
Add 150 μL of 1× TBS to each well.
Prepare the developer at this point.
Remove the TBS and add 150 μL of the developer to each well.
Read the plate on a luminometer at 425 nm immediately after adding the developer.
